documents.title: Generic Service Status Guide
expectedFacts: The sample service catalog uses three fields: record ID, status, and location.
A status of available means the sample service reports that it is ready for read-only lookup.
The catalog is refreshed every 15 minutes.

documents.title: Generic Maintenance Window Guide
expectedFacts: The sample service catalog has a planned maintenance window every Sunday from 02:00 to 03:00 UTC.
During that window, a status lookup may reflect the previous catalog refresh.
If a fact is not present in the catalog or these guides, report that it is unavailable rather than inferring an answer.
